signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.heroTitle: One plan. Everyone on the same page.
signIn.heroBody: Ideas, owners and golden times in one place, always up to date.
signIn.noAccount: Ask an admin for an account if you don't have one.

account.title: Account
account.changePasswordHint: Got a temporary password from an admin? Replace it here.

admin.title: Members
admin.intro: Who's on the team and what they can do.
admin.name: Name
admin.temporaryPasswordHint: Send it to them privately. It won't be shown again.
admin.addMemberHint: They get a temporary password to send them privately. They change it after signing in.
admin.roleHint: Members plan and make content. Admins can also handle proposals, members and agent keys.

contentList.title: Content plan
contentList.intro: Everything we plan to publish, soonest first. Open an item to see it, update its status or edit it.
contentList.emptyBody: Add the first idea so the team can plan around it.
contentList.assetLinks: {count, plural, one {# asset link} other {# asset links}}

review.title: Proposals
review.intro: Content ideas from agents. Open one to check it, then add it to the plan or turn it down with a reason.
review.emptyBody: When an agent suggests a content idea, it shows up here for you to approve or reject.
review.waiting: {count, plural, one {# idea waiting for your decision} other {# ideas waiting for your decision}}
review.doneApproved: Approved and added to the content plan.
review.doneRejected: Rejected. The agent can read your reason.

contentEditor.deleteHint: Removes it from the plan for everyone. This can't be undone.
contentEditor.confirmDelete: Delete this content from the plan?
contentEditor.goldenTimeHint: Local time when the audience is most active.

errors.goalRequired: Write the goal: what we want and why.
errors.invalidLinks: Asset links must be http(s) URLs, one per line.
errors.assigneeGone: That member no longer exists. Pick another.
errors.proposalReviewed: Someone already approved or rejected this proposal.
errors.invalidProgress: Pick a status and an owner from the lists.

comments.title: Comments
comments.count: {count, plural, =0 {No comments} one {# comment} other {# comments}}
comments.empty: No comments yet. Ask a question or leave a note for the team.
comments.label: Write a comment
comments.hint: Press Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on Mac) to send.

proposal.title: Proposed by {name}
proposal.rejectHint: The agent reads this, so say what would make the next idea better.
proposal.decideTitle: What do you want to do with it?
proposal.approveHint: It goes into the content plan as Planned, exactly as shown above.
proposal.editOptionHint: Change the idea, format, date or owner first.
proposal.rejectOptionHint: It leaves the queue. You tell the agent why, so its next idea is better.
proposal.editHint: Saving approves it and adds it to the content plan.

contentEditor.editDetailsHint: Change the brief, format, schedule or links.

myTasks.title: My tasks
myTasks.intro: Everything assigned to you. Update the status as you work, so the team knows where things stand.
myTasks.emptyBody: When someone assigns you content, it shows up here. The content plan has everything the team is working on.

errors.notAssigned: This task is no longer assigned to you.

agents.title: Agents
agents.intro: API keys let AI agents read the plan and suggest ideas. Their ideas wait in Proposals; agents can't edit, delete or approve anything.
agents.copyNow: Copy the key for {name} now. It won't be shown again.
agents.empty: No keys yet. Create one per agent, so you can turn one off without touching the others.
agents.confirmDelete: Delete the key {name}? Agents using it stop working. Their past proposals stay.

errors.nameRequired: Name the key after the agent that will use it.

connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.step1: Create a key for the agent and copy it.
connect.step2: Give the agent these two environment variables:
connect.step3: In Claude Code, the propose-content skill in this repo explains how to read the plan and propose ideas.
connect.limits: Each key can make 30 requests a minute.
